name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  build:
    name: Typecheck and package (${{ matrix.browser }})
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        browser: [chrome, edge, firefox, safari]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@ea17c68df8912ef543352723c149a84f56e3d413 # v6.1.0
        with:
          version: 10.33.2
      - uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version: 24
          cache: pnpm
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: pnpm compile
      - name: Build production store bundle
        run: pnpm exec wxt zip -b ${{ matrix.browser }} --mv3
      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup-browser
        if: matrix.browser == 'chrome'
      - name: Test real extension and ArchiveBox API flows
        if: matrix.browser == 'chrome'
        run: pnpm exec playwright test

name: Resolve browser with ArchiveBox
description: Resolve and cache Chrome from the published ArchiveBox dependency declarations.
runs:
  using: composite
  steps:
    - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v7
      with:
        cache-dependency-glob: .github/actions/setup-browser/action.yml
    - uses: actions/cache@0057852bfaa89a56745cba8c7296529d2fc39830
      with:
        path: ${{ runner.temp }}/extension-abx-lib
        key: extension-abx-lib-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('.github/actions/setup-browser/action.yml') }}
    - name: Resolve the Chrome plugin runtime
      shell: bash
      working-directory: ${{ runner.temp }}
      env:
        ABXPKG_LIB_DIR: ${{ runner.temp }}/extension-abx-lib
      run: |
        runtime=(uv run --no-project --with abx-dl==1.13.133)
        schema="$("${runtime[@]}" python -c 'from importlib.resources import files; print(files("abx_plugins") / "plugins/chrome/config.json")')"
        "${runtime[@]}" abxpkg env --install --json --deps-from="$schema:required_binaries" chromium > "$RUNNER_TEMP/chrome-env.json"
        "${runtime[@]}" python - <<'PY' >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
        import json
        import os
        from pathlib import Path

        env = json.loads((Path(os.environ["RUNNER_TEMP"]) / "chrome-env.json").read_text())
        binary = env["CHROME_BINARY"]
        assert os.access(binary, os.X_OK), binary
        print(f"CHROME_BIN={binary}")
        PY

[project]
name = "archivebox-extension-test-server"
version = "0.0.0"
requires-python = "==3.13.*"
dependencies = [
  "archivebox @ git+https://github.com/ArchiveBox/ArchiveBox.git@39c19a84ac49c091be2ea6ac3e174cf0dab6e2c0",
]

# The persona API and Chrome schema must both understand synced client hints.
# Pin this integration-test pair until both changes reach published releases;
# production dependencies still advance through the release coordinator.
[tool.uv]
override-dependencies = [
  "abx-plugins[opencode] @ git+https://github.com/ArchiveBox/abx-plugins.git@28f39eba8a9dd6d83e1ffa8f9ebc079964533fa9",
]

# README website

The landing page is rendered directly from the repository's `README.md`. Edit that file to change its content; this directory contains only presentation, navigation, and screenshot gallery generation.

Translated landing pages are independent HTML copies in `es/`, `fr/`, `zh/`, `ru/`, and `ar/`. To remove localization, delete those folders and `language.js`, then remove the small localization block at the end of `build.mjs`.

From the repository root:

```sh
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm exec playwright install chromium
pnpm build
pnpm screenshots
pnpm site:build
pnpm site:verify
```

The capture command uses the real extension and browser store pages and writes `screenshots/manifest.json` and PNG images. The build requires all expected views at desktop, tablet, and mobile sizes, and includes the capture version, revision, timestamp, and source links. It fails if any required view or image is absent. Both the captures and `_site/` are generated, ignored files; GitHub Pages publishes `_site/` as a build artifact.

For a server mounted at `/`, omit `--baseurl`. Repository-only relative links point to their source revision on GitHub; relative images are copied from the repository. Links under the canonical Pages URL are rewritten to the chosen base URL for local previews.

# Safari export acceptance data

Exported from Safari 27 on macOS 27 on 2026-09-20 using File → Export Browsing Data to File. The example.com test page was visited, bookmarked, and added to Reading List through Safari's UI. Only that public test URL is retained here; unrelated personal entries and empty bookmark folders were removed. History metadata, visit timestamp, titles, and Reading List identifier are from the actual export.

Safari 27 exports Bookmarks.html and ReadingList.html separately. Earlier documented exports put Reading List inside Bookmarks.html. The importer identifies the Reading List by `com.apple.ReadingList`, independently of filenames or localized folder labels.

name: Publish website

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: ['Capture extension screenshots']
    types: [completed]
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: read
  actions: read

env:
  # Repository-specific output; all publication logic below is a local copy.
  SITE_OUTPUT: docs/site/_site
  DEFAULT_BRANCH: ${{ github.event.repository.default_branch }}

# One production queue covers restore, build and deploy. PRs have separate queues.
concurrency:
  group: pages-${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.ref || 'production' }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  build:
    if: github.event_name != 'workflow_run' || github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    outputs:
      revision: ${{ steps.source.outputs.revision }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.ref || env.DEFAULT_BRANCH }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Record website source revision
        id: source
        run: echo "revision=$(git rev-parse HEAD)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      # BEGIN REPOSITORY-SPECIFIC BUILD
      - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v7
      - name: Restore latest complete screenshots
        run: uv run --no-project python docs/site/restore-screenshots.py docs/site/screenshots
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10.33.2
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 24
          cache: pnpm
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts
      - name: Render current README and existing screenshot gallery
        run: pnpm site:build
      # END REPOSITORY-SPECIFIC BUILD

      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup-browser
      - name: Verify website in Chromium
        run: |
          uv run --no-config --no-project --with playwright==1.63.0 python .github/pages/verify.py "$SITE_OUTPUT" --evidence "$RUNNER_TEMP/site-evidence"
      - name: Save website verification evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: site-verification
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/site-evidence
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 14

      - name: Upload website
        uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v3
        with:
          path: ${{ env.SITE_OUTPUT }}

  deploy:
    if: github.event_name != 'pull_request'
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pages: write
      id-token: write
    environment:
      name: github-pages
      url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/configure-pages@v5
      - uses: actions/deploy-pages@v4
        id: deployment

name: Capture extension screenshots

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'src/**'
      - 'entrypoints/**'
      - 'public/**'
      - 'locales/**'
      - 'wxt.config.ts'
      - 'package.json'
      - 'pnpm-lock.yaml'
      - 'scripts/capture-screenshots.mjs'
      - 'tests/helpers/extension.ts'
      - 'tests/helpers/archivebox.ts'
      - '.github/actions/setup-browser/**'
      - '.github/workflows/screenshots.yml'
  schedule:
    - cron: '49 5,17 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  actions: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  changes:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    outputs:
      changed: ${{ steps.check.outputs.changed }}
      key: ${{ steps.check.outputs.key }}
      backend: ${{ steps.check.outputs.backend }}
    steps:
      - id: check
        uses: ArchiveBox/monorepo/.github/actions/changed-scheduled-inputs@main


  build:
    needs: changes
    if: needs.changes.outputs.changed == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@ea17c68df8912ef543352723c149a84f56e3d413 # v6.1.0
        with:
          version: 10.33.2
      - uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version: 24
          cache: pnpm
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup-browser
      - run: pnpm compile
      - run: pnpm build
      - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v7
      - name: Capture real extension screens and public store listings
        run: pnpm screenshots
      - name: Render README and screenshot gallery
        run: pnpm site:build
      - name: Verify published paths, images, and responsive gallery
        run: pnpm site:verify
      - name: Preserve capture evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4
        with:
          name: extension-screenshots
          path: |
            docs/site/screenshots/
            tmp/screenshot-capture-failure/
            test-results/site/
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 14
      - name: Save validated screenshot gallery
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: site-screenshots
          path: docs/site/screenshots
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 90

  complete:
    name: 'Scheduled inputs: ${{ needs.changes.outputs.key }}'
    needs: [changes, build]
    if: needs.changes.outputs.changed == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - run: echo 'Scheduled work completed successfully.'

name: Release browser extension

on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: [CI]
    types: [completed]
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: read
  actions: read

concurrency:
  group: browser-store-release
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  inspect:
    if: >-
      github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success' &&
      github.event.workflow_run.event == 'push' &&
      github.event.workflow_run.head_repository.full_name == github.repository
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    outputs:
      candidate: ${{ steps.classify.outputs.candidate }}
      prepare: ${{ steps.classify.outputs.prepare }}
      version: ${{ steps.classify.outputs.version }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Classify tested main commit
        id: classify
        shell: bash
        env:
          TESTED_SHA: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_sha }}
        run: |
          git fetch origin main --tags
          VERSION="$(node -p 'require("./package.json").version')"
          echo "version=$VERSION" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          if test "$(git rev-list -n 1 "v$VERSION" 2>/dev/null || true)" = "$TESTED_SHA"; then
            git merge-base --is-ancestor "$TESTED_SHA" origin/main
            if ! git diff --quiet "$TESTED_SHA" origin/main -- entrypoints src public locales wxt.config.ts package.json pnpm-lock.yaml; then
              echo 'Tagged candidate superseded by newer extension source; the newer CI run will reserve the next version.'
              echo 'candidate=false' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo 'prepare=false' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              exit 0
            fi
            echo 'candidate=true' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo 'prepare=false' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            exit 0
          fi
          if test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" != "$TESTED_SHA"; then
            echo 'A newer main commit has its own CI run; skipping stale source.'
            echo 'candidate=false' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo 'prepare=false' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            exit 0
          fi
          if git log -1 --format=%s | grep -q '^chore(release): bump extension to '; then
            echo 'Release commit has no matching version tag' >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          LAST_TAG="$(git tag --merged HEAD --list 'v[0-9]*' --sort=-version:refname | head -n 1)"
          if test -n "$LAST_TAG" && git diff --quiet "$LAST_TAG" HEAD -- entrypoints src public locales wxt.config.ts package.json pnpm-lock.yaml; then
            echo 'prepare=false' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo 'candidate=false' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            exit 0
          fi
          echo 'prepare=true' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo 'candidate=false' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

  prepare:
    needs: inspect
    if: needs.inspect.outputs.prepare == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          token: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_GH_TOKEN }}
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 24
      - name: Allocate the next unreserved patch version
        shell: bash
        env:
          TESTED_SHA: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_sha }}
          RELEASE_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_GH_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          test -n "$RELEASE_TOKEN" || { echo 'RELEASE_GH_TOKEN is unavailable' >&2; exit 1; }
          test "$(git ls-remote origin refs/heads/main | cut -f1)" = "$TESTED_SHA"
          git fetch origin --tags
          node --input-type=module <<'NODE'
          import { readFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
          import { execFileSync } from 'node:child_process';
          const pkg = JSON.parse(readFileSync('package.json', 'utf8'));
          const versions = [pkg.version, ...execFileSync('git', ['tag', '--list', 'v*'], { encoding: 'utf8' }).trim().split('\n').map(tag => tag.replace(/^v/, ''))]
            .filter(version => /^\d+\.\d+\.\d+$/.test(version))
            .map(version => version.split('.').map(Number));
          versions.sort((a, b) => b[0] - a[0] || b[1] - a[1] || b[2] - a[2]);
          const [major, minor, patch] = versions[0];
          const version = `${major}.${minor}.${patch + 1}`;
          pkg.version = version;
          writeFileSync('package.json', JSON.stringify(pkg, null, 2) + '\n');
          writeFileSync(process.env.GITHUB_ENV, `VERSION=${version}\n`, { flag: 'a' });
          NODE
      - name: Commit and atomically reserve the version
        shell: bash
        env:
          TESTED_SHA: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_sha }}
        run: |
          test "$(git ls-remote origin refs/heads/main | cut -f1)" = "$TESTED_SHA"
          git config user.name 'archivebox-release-bot'
          git config user.email 'release-bot@archivebox.io'
          git add package.json
          git commit -m "chore(release): bump extension to $VERSION"
          git tag "v$VERSION"
          git push --atomic origin HEAD:main "refs/tags/v$VERSION"

  package:
    needs: inspect
    if: needs.inspect.outputs.candidate == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    outputs:
      version: ${{ needs.inspect.outputs.version }}
      release_sha: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_sha }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Confirm the versioned CI commit still owns main and its tag
        shell: bash
        env:
          TESTED_SHA: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_sha }}
          VERSION: ${{ needs.inspect.outputs.version }}
        run: |
          git fetch origin main
          git merge-base --is-ancestor "$TESTED_SHA" origin/main
          git diff --quiet "$TESTED_SHA" origin/main -- entrypoints src public locales wxt.config.ts package.json pnpm-lock.yaml
          test "$(git ls-remote origin "refs/tags/v$VERSION")" = "$TESTED_SHA$(printf '\t')refs/tags/v$VERSION"
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10.33.2
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 24
          cache: pnpm
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: pnpm compile
      - name: Build all store packages from the versioned CI commit
        run: pnpm zip:stores
      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup-browser
      - name: Test import, options, retention, and registry flows
        run: pnpm exec playwright test tests/safari-import.test.ts tests/options-responsive.test.ts tests/retention.test.ts tests/server_registry.test.ts
      - name: Verify local capture and reject unconfirmed submissions
        run: pnpm exec playwright test tests/popup.test.ts --grep 'action popup saves MHTML|HTTP 200 from a normal website'
      - name: Verify package versions and source bundle
        shell: bash
        env:
          VERSION: ${{ needs.inspect.outputs.version }}
        run: |
          node --input-type=module <<'NODE'
          import { execFileSync } from 'node:child_process';
          import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
          const version = process.env.VERSION;
          for (const browser of ['chrome', 'edge', 'firefox']) {
            const zip = `.output/archivebox-browser-extension-${version}-${browser}.zip`;
            const manifest = JSON.parse(execFileSync('unzip', ['-p', zip, 'manifest.json'], { encoding: 'utf8' }));
            if (manifest.version !== version) throw new Error(`${browser} manifest version differs from package.json`);
          }
          const source = `.output/archivebox-browser-extension-${version}-sources.zip`;
          const names = execFileSync('unzip', ['-Z1', source], { encoding: 'utf8' }).split('\n');
          if (!names.includes('package.json') || !names.includes('pnpm-lock.yaml') || names.some(name => /(^|\/)(\.env[^/]*|node_modules|tmp|test-results)(\/|$)/.test(name))) {
            throw new Error('Firefox source bundle is incomplete or contains local data');
          }
          const pkg = JSON.parse(readFileSync('package.json', 'utf8'));
          if (pkg.version !== version) throw new Error('Version changed after tests');
          NODE
          sha256sum .output/archivebox-browser-extension-"$VERSION"-{chrome,edge,firefox,sources}.zip > .output/store-package-sha256.txt
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: store-packages-${{ needs.inspect.outputs.version }}
          path: |
            .output/archivebox-browser-extension-${{ needs.inspect.outputs.version }}-chrome.zip
            .output/archivebox-browser-extension-${{ needs.inspect.outputs.version }}-edge.zip
            .output/archivebox-browser-extension-${{ needs.inspect.outputs.version }}-firefox.zip
            .output/archivebox-browser-extension-${{ needs.inspect.outputs.version }}-sources.zip
            .output/store-package-sha256.txt
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 90

  chrome:
    needs: package
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.package.outputs.release_sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10.33.2
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 24
          cache: pnpm
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: store-packages-${{ needs.package.outputs.version }}
          path: .output
      - name: Verify tested package hashes
        run: sha256sum --check .output/store-package-sha256.txt
      - name: Submit Chrome package
        id: submit
        continue-on-error: true
        run: pnpm submit:chrome
        env:
          CHROME_CLIENT_ID: ${{ secrets.CHROME_CLIENT_ID }}
          CHROME_CLIENT_SECRET: ${{ secrets.CHROME_CLIENT_SECRET }}
          CHROME_REFRESH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CHROME_REFRESH_TOKEN }}
      - name: Record Chrome submission receipt
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        env:
          VERSION: ${{ needs.package.outputs.version }}
          RELEASE_SHA: ${{ needs.package.outputs.release_sha }}
          RESULT: ${{ steps.submit.outcome }}
        run: |
          sha256sum .output/archivebox-browser-extension-"$VERSION"-chrome.zip > chrome.sha256
          printf 'store=chrome\nversion=%s\nrelease_sha=%s\nsubmit_result=%s\n' "$VERSION" "$RELEASE_SHA" "$RESULT" > chrome-receipt.txt
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: chrome-submission-receipt
          path: |
            chrome.sha256
            chrome-receipt.txt
          if-no-files-found: warn
      - if: steps.submit.outcome != 'success'
        run: exit 1

  firefox:
    needs: package
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.package.outputs.release_sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10.33.2
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 24
          cache: pnpm
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: store-packages-${{ needs.package.outputs.version }}
          path: .output
      - name: Verify tested package hashes
        run: sha256sum --check .output/store-package-sha256.txt
      - name: Submit Firefox package and sources
        id: submit
        continue-on-error: true
        run: pnpm submit:firefox
        env:
          FIREFOX_JWT_ISSUER: ${{ secrets.FIREFOX_JWT_ISSUER }}
          FIREFOX_JWT_SECRET: ${{ secrets.FIREFOX_JWT_SECRET }}
      - name: Record Firefox submission receipt
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        env:
          VERSION: ${{ needs.package.outputs.version }}
          RELEASE_SHA: ${{ needs.package.outputs.release_sha }}
          RESULT: ${{ steps.submit.outcome }}
        run: |
          sha256sum .output/archivebox-browser-extension-"$VERSION"-{firefox,sources}.zip > firefox.sha256
          printf 'store=firefox\nversion=%s\nrelease_sha=%s\nsubmit_result=%s\n' "$VERSION" "$RELEASE_SHA" "$RESULT" > firefox-receipt.txt
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: firefox-submission-receipt
          path: |
            firefox.sha256
            firefox-receipt.txt
          if-no-files-found: warn
      - if: steps.submit.outcome != 'success'
        run: exit 1

  edge:
    needs: package
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.package.outputs.release_sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10.33.2
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 24
          cache: pnpm
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: store-packages-${{ needs.package.outputs.version }}
          path: .output
      - name: Verify tested package hashes
        run: sha256sum --check .output/store-package-sha256.txt
      - name: Submit Edge package
        id: submit
        continue-on-error: true
        run: pnpm submit:edge
        env:
          EDGE_PRODUCT_ID: ${{ secrets.EDGE_PRODUCT_ID }}
          EDGE_CLIENT_ID: ${{ secrets.EDGE_CLIENT_ID }}
          EDGE_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.EDGE_API_KEY }}
      - name: Record Edge submission receipt
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        env:
          VERSION: ${{ needs.package.outputs.version }}
          RELEASE_SHA: ${{ needs.package.outputs.release_sha }}
          RESULT: ${{ steps.submit.outcome }}
        run: |
          sha256sum .output/archivebox-browser-extension-"$VERSION"-edge.zip > edge.sha256
          printf 'store=edge\nversion=%s\nrelease_sha=%s\nsubmit_result=%s\n' "$VERSION" "$RELEASE_SHA" "$RESULT" > edge-receipt.txt
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: edge-submission-receipt
          path: |
            edge.sha256
            edge-receipt.txt
          if-no-files-found: warn
      - if: steps.submit.outcome != 'success'
        run: exit 1

  sync_safari_source:
    needs: package
    uses: ArchiveBox/monorepo/.github/workflows/cascade-source-pin.yml@main
    with:
      source_tag: v${{ needs.package.outputs.version }}
      source_sha: ${{ needs.package.outputs.release_sha }}
      artifact_name: store-packages-${{ needs.package.outputs.version }}
    secrets:
      release_token: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_GH_TOKEN }}
